The company makes different designs depending on whether the awning is made to block sunrises or sunsets. I will extract numeric street numbers and also compute the number of unique street addresses (to avoid potential duplicates by address). Then we can proceed to classify by parity.

```python
import pandas as pd
import re
file_path = '/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/4d51c4bf-4b0e-4f3d-897b-3f6687a7d9f2.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(file_path)
# Extract leading number
df['Street_Number'] = df['Street Address'].str.extract(r'^(\d+)').astype(int)
# Unique addresses
unique_df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['Street Address']).copy()
print('Total rows:', len(df))
print('Unique addresses:', len(unique_df))
print(unique_df[['Street Address','Street_Number']].to_string(index=False))
```
